description: A revised landslide inventory of the Campania region (Italy) is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Francesco Fusco et al. Landslides represent a severe geohazard in many countries. The availability of inventories depicting the spatial and temporal distribution of landslides supports assessments of landslide susceptibility and risk for territorial planning or investigating landscape evolution. Nevertheless, these inventories are usually affected by limitations due to their nonpublic availability and inhomogeneities in characterization and mapping. Coverage: national (IT); published in 2023. Formats: CSV, Shapefile. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
